name: Plastic Mulching
benefit:
1. Small/marginal farmers can get a 25% subsidy on up to 2 hectares of land.
1. Other farmers can get a 50% subsidy on up to 2 hectares of land.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant must have agricultural land ownership and irrigation sources.
